title.description: Table title displayed above the table (use this instead of a separate Text widget for the table heading)

key.description: Data column key (matches SQL output column name)

showSummaryRow.description: Append a totals row at the bottom (aggregates metric columns)

defaultSortKey.description: Column key the table is sorted by initially — set to the primary metric

defaultSortDir.description: Initial sort direction (default: desc for metrics)

columnConfig.description: Maps SQL columns to table columns. Extended display fields MUST be set here (config.columns is rebuilt from this mapping)

format.description: Display format: currency, percent, date, number

displayType.description: Metric cell rendering: 'bar' = in-cell bar (great for rankings), 'heatmap' = color-scaled background (dense numeric comparison)

showBarValue.description: Show the numeric value next to the in-cell bar (displayType 'bar' only)

aggregation.description: Aggregation used for the summary row

comparisonCalc.description: Show the metric relative to the column total/max (e.g. 'percentOfTotal' for share-of-total questions)

runningCalc.description: Running calculation down the rows (e.g. 'runningSum' for cumulative totals)
